name: Build Sentri APK

# Builds the APK from sentri-repo.zip at the top of this repo.
# Runs automatically on every push to main, or by hand: Actions > Build Sentri APK > Run workflow.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Unpack the code
        run: unzip -q sentri-repo.zip -d code

      - name: Find the Flutter project
        id: find
        run: |
          P=$(dirname "$(find code -name pubspec.yaml -not -path '*/.*' | head -1)")
          echo "Flutter project: $P"
          echo "dir=$P" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Generate Android scaffolding, keep our own sources
        working-directory: ${{ steps.find.outputs.dir }}
        run: |
          cp -R android/app/src/main /tmp/our_main
          flutter create . --org ng.sentri --project-name sentri --platforms=android
          rm -rf android/app/src/main && cp -R /tmp/our_main android/app/src/main

      - name: Patch Gradle (minSdk 26, core library desugaring)
        working-directory: ${{ steps.find.outputs.dir }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, re
          kts, groovy = 'android/app/build.gradle.kts', 'android/app/build.gradle'
          path = kts if os.path.exists(kts) else groovy
          s = open(path).read()
          s = re.sub(r'flutter\.minSdkVersion', '26', s)
          if path == kts:
              if 'isCoreLibraryDesugaringEnabled' not in s:
                  s = s.replace('compileOptions {', 'compileOptions {\n        isCoreLibraryDesugaringEnabled = true', 1)
              if 'coreLibraryDesugaring(' not in s:
                  s += '\ndependencies {\n    coreLibraryDesugaring("com.android.tools:desugar_jdk_libs:2.1.4")\n}\n'
          else:
              if 'coreLibraryDesugaringEnabled' not in s:
                  s = s.replace('compileOptions {', 'compileOptions {\n        coreLibraryDesugaringEnabled true', 1)
              if 'coreLibraryDesugaring ' not in s:
                  s += "\ndependencies {\n    coreLibraryDesugaring 'com.android.tools:desugar_jdk_libs:2.1.4'\n}\n"
          open(path, 'w').write(s)
          PY

      - name: Get packages
        working-directory: ${{ steps.find.outputs.dir }}
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Analyze
        working-directory: ${{ steps.find.outputs.dir }}
        run: flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings 2>&1 | tee "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/analyze.log"
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Unit tests
        working-directory: ${{ steps.find.outputs.dir }}
        run: flutter test 2>&1 | tee "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/test.log"
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Build the APK
        working-directory: ${{ steps.find.outputs.dir }}
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          flutter build apk --release \
            --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=${{ secrets.API_BASE_URL || 'https://api.example.invalid' }} \
            2>&1 | tee "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/build.log"

      - name: Upload APK
        if: success()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sentri-apk
          path: code/**/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk

      - name: Upload logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: logs
          path: |
            analyze.log
            test.log
            build.log
